tracks.title: O Son of the Supreme
tracks.lyricsPlain:
Fuente: Baha'i Blog — https://www.bahaiblog.net/music/studio-session/o-son-of-the-supreme-by-carsten-oostema/

O SON OF THE SUPREME! I have made death a messenger of joy to thee. Wherefore dost thou grieve? I made the light to shed on thee its splendor. Why dost thou veil thyself therefrom?

Open D tuning

tracks.title: I Am the Lamp
tracks.lyricsPlain:
Fuente: Baha'i Blog — https://www.bahaiblog.net/music/studio-session/i-am-the-lamp-by-priya-williams-keivan-abtahi/

I am the Mystic Fane which the Hand of Omnipotence hath reared. I am the Lamp which the Finger of God hath lit within its niche and caused to shine with deathless splendor. I am the Flame of that supernal Light that glowed upon Sinai in the gladsome Spot, and lay concealed in the midst of the Burning Bush.

tracks.title: Blessed Are the Steadfast
tracks.lyricsPlain:
Fuente: Baha'i Blog — https://www.bahaiblog.net/music/recording-artist/samuel-eckl-blessed-are-the-steadfast-ft-melody-mccants/

Blessed is he who in the prime of his youth and the heyday of his life will arise to serve the Cause of the Lord of the beginning and of the end, and adorn his heart with His love […] Blessed are the steadfast and well is it with those who are firm.

A race of men, incomparable in character, shall be raised up which, with the feet of detachment, will tread under all who are in heaven and on earth…

tracks.title: Prayer for Mothers
tracks.lyricsPlain:
Fuente: Baha'i Blog — https://www.bahaiblog.net/music/studio-session/prayer-for-mothers-by-goleta-burriston/

O Thou forgiving God! Forgive the sins of my loving mother, pardon her shortcomings, cast upon her the glance of Thy gracious providence, and enable her to gain admittance into Thy Kingdom. O God! From the earliest days of my life she educated and nurtured me, yet I did not recompense her for her toil and labours. Do Thou reward her by granting her eternal life and making her exalted in Thy Kingdom. Verily, Thou art the Forgiver, the Bestower, and the Kind.

C, Am, Dm, G

tracks.title: O Son of Earth!
tracks.lyricsPlain:
Fuente: Baha'i Blog — https://www.bahaiblog.net/music/studio-session/o-son-of-earth-by-jonathon-bryan/

O SON OF EARTH! Wouldst thou have Me, seek none other than Me; and wouldst thou gaze upon My beauty, close thine eyes to the world and all that is therein; for My will and the will of another than Me, even as fire and water, cannot dwell together in one heart.

G C Am G

D C Am G

tracks.title: Ridvan Tablet
tracks.lyricsPlain:
Fuente: Baha'i Blog — https://www.bahaiblog.net/music/studio-session/ridvan-tablet-by-wellon-sina/

Rejoice with exceeding gladness, O people of Bahá, as ye call to remembrance the Day of supreme felicity, the Day whereon the Tongue of the Ancient of Days hath spoken, as He departed from His House, proceeding to the Spot from which He shed upon the whole of creation the splendours of His name, the All-Merciful. God is Our witness. Were We to reveal the hidden secrets of that Day, all they that dwell on earth and in the heavens would swoon away and die, except such as will be preserved by God, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

tracks.title: Rejoice!
tracks.lyricsPlain:
Fuente: Baha'i Blog — https://www.bahaiblog.net/music/studio-session/rejoice-by-nik-matty/

"When a man turns his face to God he finds sunshine everywhere." – Abdu'l-Baha
"When a soul has in it the life of the spirit then does it bring forth good fruit…" – Abdu'l-Baha
"Rejoice in the gladness of thine heart, that thou mayest be worthy to meet Me and to mirror forth My beauty." – Baha'u'llah
"I want you to be happy… to laugh, smile and rejoice in order that others may be made happy by you." – Abdu'l-Baha

tracks.title: Oración de Jóvenes (Prayer for Youth)
tracks.lyricsPlain:
Fuente: Baha'i Blog — https://www.bahaiblog.net/music/studio-session/oracion-de-jovenes-prayer-for-youth-by-mayca-enrique/

Oh Señor, haz radiante a este joven y confiere tu generosidad a esta pobre criatura otórgale conocimiento, concédele más fuerza al romper el alba cada mañana y resguárdalo al amparo de Tu protección para que se libre del error pueda consagrarse al servicio de Tu Causa, pueda guiar a los descarriados, encaminar a los desventurados, liberar a los cautivos y despertar a los desatentos, para que todos sean bendecidos por Tu recuerdo y Tu alabanza Tu eres el Poderoso y el Potente.

C#m7, B5, Asus2 C#m, B5, Asus2

tracks.title: My Hope Is in Thee
tracks.lyricsPlain:
Fuente: Baha'i Blog — https://www.bahaiblog.net/music/studio-session/my-hope-is-in-thee-by-amelia-rowhani/

O Thou beloved of my heart and soul! I have no refuge save Thee. I raise no voice at dawn save in Thy commemoration and praise. Thy love encompasseth me and Thy grace is perfect. My hope is in Thee.

O God, give me a new life at every instant and bestow upon me the breaths of the Holy Spirit at every moment, in order that I may remain steadfast in Thy love, attain unto great felicity, perceive the manifest light and be in the state of utmost tranquillity and submissiveness.

Verily, Thou art the Giver, the Forgiver, the Compassionate.

Capo 5

Am, Em, G, D

tracks.title: Ha engem akarsz (Wouldst Thou Have Me)
tracks.lyricsPlain:
Fuente: Baha'i Blog — https://www.bahaiblog.net/music/studio-session/ha-engem-akarsz-wouldst-thou-have-me-by-mariann-lilla-annamaria-orsolya-bela/

Ó, föld fia! Ha Engem akarsz, ne keress mást, csak Engem; ha az Én szépségemet kívánod látni, fordítsd el tekinteted minden világi dologtól; mert az én akaratom, s valaki más akarata olyan, mint tűz és víz, egy szívben a kettő nem fér meg.
